name: app-health-score-phone-tilted-between-chrome-brackets
title: Health Score Phone between Chrome Brackets
whatItIs: A pale blue cover with a phone tilted at a steep angle showing a 92% AI health score and metric cards, held between two chrome bracket shapes at the corners, a logo lockup bottom left and a discipline tag top right.
whatItMeans: Chrome forms cradle the phone like a machine, adding a hard-edged industrial contrast to the soft UI.
techniques: Chrome brackets at two corners as a frame
Phone rotated diagonally across the frame
Logo lockup and discipline tag in opposite corners
Sunburst score graphic in the UI

vocabulary.definition: A metal L-shaped form used as a scene prop.
A phone rotated off-axis to add motion.
Small labels at the frame corners.
